files.content:
# Tape 04 - Opa Willem's 80th birthday (spring 1998)

Digitized from VHS. Timestamps are tape time.

[00:00:40] Guests arriving at the farmhouse. Oma Ria at the door taking coats, waving at the camera.
[00:03:12] Marloes and Sofie stringing the paper garlands in the kitchen, arguing sweetly about the ladder.
[00:08:55] Opa Willem's toast. He stands, taps the glass, and gives the speech everyone still quotes - eighty years and the same bicycle. The whole room on its feet by the end.
[00:14:30] The singing. Tante Els starts Lang zal hij leven and the room joins in, second verse louder than the first.
[00:21:05] Jeroen tells the flooded-kitchen story from 1976. Opa Willem laughing so hard he has to put his glass down.
[00:27:48] Bram's first steps, right there in the background while the cake is being served. Half the room misses it, the camera does not.
[00:33:20] A quiet moment. Opa Willem and Oma Ria alone on the bench by the window, saying nothing.
[00:38:02] Goodbyes at the door, headlights in the lane, Oma Ria waving until the last car turns.

# Family roster

- Opa Willem - grandfather, the storyteller of the family
- Oma Ria - grandmother, married to Willem since 1948
- Tante Els - Willem and Ria's eldest, starts every song
- Marloes - granddaughter, organized most of the parties
- Jeroen - grandson, keeper of the embarrassing stories
- Sofie - granddaughter, Marloes' sister
- Bram - great-grandson, born 1997

# Indexing log - prior tapes

Moments indexed so far, by tape and tape-time:

- tape-01 [00:02:10] Willem and Ria dancing at the 1985 street party
- tape-01 [00:19:44] Els singing at the piano
- tape-02 [00:05:31] the sisters and the shared bike
- tape-02 [00:28:07] the fishing cast into the reeds
- tape-03 [00:11:59] the chisel-sharpening lesson
- tape-03 [00:36:22] baking day, flour everywhere
